answer: Problem: at dawn sybil farms flood markets with cloned wallets before honest stake lands. Mechanism: each agent locks 1.2 POA in a rotating vault keyed to join txid; vault issues a lantern spend-token every 90 min that must buy one unique challenge answer, and any 16-byte hash collision burns both deposits. Cost: 1.2 POA locked 3 epochs (~18h). Verification: peers match vault receipt, lantern nonce, and answer distance on tip. Failure: two missed spends refund 40% and freeze the vault until a fresh bond posts.
